items.q: Yeah, Moore and Pops -- Pops Foster.

ctx.x: Well, could be. But I know that one of the bass... When Pops was there, he still had tuba there, too. Both of them were there. Pops Foster had just come in, you know, and both of them were there on the same date. Yeah, Moore and Pops -- Pops Foster. See, he was getting a band together.
